summary: Master the essentials of humanitarian logistics and supply chain management. Enroll in our training to empower your career and impact communities globally.
lede: Humanitarian logistics training helps response, operations, procurement, and warehouse professionals connect needs assessment, sourcing, storage, transport, and distribution. Participants learn to forecast demand, manage stock and pipeline visibility, document procurement decisions, plan last-mile delivery, and track operational risks and performance. The syllabus also covers ethical sourcing, audit records, and coordination when access or supply conditions are uncertain.
audienceIntro: This course is tailored for professionals across various sectors involved in humanitarian logistics and supply chain management. It aims to equip them with the necessary skills to handle complex logistical challenges effectively.
audience: Humanitarian logistics and supply chain officers
Procurement and contract management professionals in NGOs/UN
Government disaster management and emergency coordination teams
modules: Needs Assessment, Demand Planning, and Forecasting
Contracts, Vendor Management, and Compliance Documentation
Pipeline Visibility and Logistics Information Systems
Transport Planning, Fleet Management, and Routing
Last-Mile Distribution and Accountability to Affected Populations
Risk Management and Continuity Planning in Humanitarian Supply Chains
Performance Measurement and Value for Money in Humanitarian Logistics
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of supply chain management principles and experience in humanitarian or logistics operations is recommended.
